title: did / didn't: preguntas y negativas en pasado
short: Did you go? I didn't go. Con did, el verbo vuelve a su forma base. Igual para todas las personas.

story.title: El ayudante del pasado
story.text: ¿Te acuerdas de do y does? En pasado el ayudante es ==did==, y vale para todas las personas. Con él preguntamos y negamos.

story.title: Las cuatro formas
story.text: Fíjate: en la negativa y la pregunta el verbo va ==sin pasado==, en su forma base.

head: Afirmativa
Negativa
Pregunta
Respuesta corta
rows: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
Yes, she did. / No, she didn't.
Yes, we did. / No, we didn't.
Yes, they did. / No, they didn't.

story.title: El pasado se lo queda did
story.text: Did ya dice «pasado». Por eso el verbo no repite el pasado: ==did + go==, nunca did + went. Una sola marca de pasado por frase.

examples.t: I bought it. → I didn't buy it.

story.title: Con where, what, how…
story.text: Palabra de pregunta + ==did== + sujeto + verbo base.

story.title: Así en español, así en inglés
story.text: En español basta con el tono: ¿Fuiste? No fui. En inglés hace falta ==did== delante. ¡Ojo! Con was/were no se usa did: ==Were== you tired?

examples.t: Did you go? — I didn't go.

story.title: Errores típicos
story.text:
❌ I didn't went. ✅ I didn't ==go==.
❌ Did you saw it? ✅ Did you ==see== it?
❌ Where you went? ✅ Where ==did== you ==go==?
❌ Did you were tired? ✅ ==Were== you tired?

story.title: Truco: una sola marca
story.text: En cada frase hay ==una sola marca de pasado==: o el verbo en pasado (I went), o did + verbo base (I didn't go). Nunca las dos.

compare.es: En español la pregunta y la negativa en pasado usan el mismo verbo: ¿Fuiste? No fui. Basta con el tono o con «no».
compare.target: En inglés el pasado simple necesita el ayudante did para preguntar y negar: Did you go? I didn't go. El verbo vuelve a su forma base. Con was/were no se usa did.

errors.wrong: I didn't went to the party.
errors.right: I didn't go to the party.
errors.why: Después de didn't, el verbo en forma base.
Did ya marca el pasado: el verbo va en forma base.

errors.right: Where did you go on holiday?
errors.why: En las preguntas hace falta did delante del sujeto.
Con was/were no se usa did: se invierte el verbo.

errors.wrong: Did you like it? — Yes, I liked.
errors.right: Did you like it? — Yes, I did.
errors.why: La respuesta corta repite el ayudante: Yes, I did.
En inglés no se niega con «no»: hace falta didn't.

exercises.q: ___ you go to the beach last summer?
exercises.why: Pregunta en pasado con un verbo normal: Did.

exercises.q: I didn't ___ the film. Was it good?
exercises.why: Después de didn't, el verbo en forma base: see.

exercises.q: Last week we ___ have time for the museum.
exercises.why: Last week es pasado: didn't + have.

exercises.q: Did you enjoy the trip? — Yes, I ___.
exercises.why: La respuesta corta repite el ayudante: Yes, I did.

exercises.q: Where ___ you stay in London last year?

exercises.why: Con tired usamos to be: Were you tired? Sin did.

exercises.q: I ___ sleep well on the plane.
exercises.es: No dormí bien en el avión.
exercises.why: Negativa en pasado: didn't + verbo base.
Pregunta en pasado: Did she like…?

exercises.q: How did you ___ to the airport?
exercises.why: Después de did, el verbo en forma base: get.

exercises.q: Did they see the cathedral? — No, they ___.
exercises.why: Respuesta corta negativa: No, they didn't.

exercises.q: My friend didn't ___ the bus. She walked.
exercises.es: Mi amiga no cogió el autobús. Fue andando.

answer: I didn't buy a new phone.
I did not buy a new phone.
We didn't go to the market.
We did not go to the market.
She didn't tell me the news.
She did not tell me the news.
Did they have a good time?
Did your son come for dinner?

exercises.instr: Pregunta por el lugar con Where
exercises.q: You stayed in a small hotel.
I didn't went to the party.
exercises.why: Después de didn't, forma base: go.
Did ya marca el pasado: see.

exercises.q: Where did you went on holiday?
exercises.why: Where did you go…? El verbo en forma base.
También con los regulares: did + enjoy, sin -ed.

exercises.es: No vi a mi amiga en el mercado
exercises.answer: I didn't see my friend at the market
Did you have a good time in York

answer: Did you go to the beach?

exercises.context: Tu hijo vuelve de un viaje. Quieres saber si le gustó.
Una amiga te pregunta si fuiste a la boda. No fuiste.
exercises.why: Pregunta con did → respuesta corta con didn't.
Con did se responde con did; con was/were, con was/were.
